task: Enumerate and minimize countermodels over larger typed workflow graphs, alternative supports, cycles, and regime paths.

what_each_theorem_asserts.OSTC-T8: For every one of the six SANF witness factors (R,V,X,S,E,B) there exists a matched countermodel in W-dagger in which that factor alone fails, all others held fixed, and the admitting terminal changes. Therefore no factor is eliminable from a class containing these models.
what_each_theorem_asserts.OSTC-T10: Two certificates compose exactly when the produced and consumed intermediate object, content, responsibility, scope, epoch, authority and blocker contracts match or are related by a registered bridge. Composition is associative, identity certificates are empty traces with reflexive bridges, and mismatched contracts yield a typed countermodel rather than a coercion by convention.
what_each_theorem_asserts.OSTC-T13: For regime morphisms f and g, transport is path independent iff every load-bearing coordinate satisfies a commuting coherence square. Where a square fails, an object supported on the differing coordinate yields different obligations or terminals.

code_identity.checker_independence: The checker must not import the runner. It recomputes each verdict from the raw atlas through a separately written predicate set and must be able to disagree.

data_identity.no_external_data: This job consumes no external corpus. The enumeration is total over the declared parameter grid, not sampled.

comparator_identity.information_equivalent_donor: A donor witness carrying the same information as the six-factor witness but without factor typing. Per the issue's execution discipline it should TIE on admitting decisions; any apparent superiority is to be investigated as hidden information or resource asymmetry, not reported as a win.

information_and_tool_access.runner: declared parameter grid only; no network, no model calls, no external corpus
information_and_tool_access.checker: raw atlas JSON only; no access to runner internals

resource_vector.memory_bound_note: atlas held in memory; counts and minimal witnesses persisted, not the full cross product

independent_unit: The (theorem, factor-or-coordinate) cell. Individual enumerated models within a cell are exhaustive enumeration points, not independent samples, and no interval is computed over them.

estimands.T8: For each of the six factors, does at least one matched countermodel exist in the enumerated class (existence, not rate)?
estimands.T10: Over all enumerated certificate triples: does associativity hold wherever composition is defined; do identity laws hold; and does every contract mismatch produce a typed countermodel rather than a silent composition (universally quantified, not a rate)?
estimands.T13: Over all enumerated regime-morphism pairs: is path-independence exactly equivalent to all load-bearing coordinate squares commuting (biconditional, checked in both directions)?

multiplicity: No hypothesis test is performed and no p-value is computed. The estimands are existence and universal claims over a total enumeration, so multiplicity correction does not apply. Counts are reported with their denominators.
positive_conditions: all six T8 factors have at least one matched countermodel in the enumerated class
zero associativity violations and zero identity-law violations where composition is defined
zero silent compositions under contract mismatch (every mismatch is typed)
the T13 biconditional holds in both directions with zero exceptions
the information-equivalent donor ties on admitting decisions
negative_conditions: any T8 factor has no countermodel in the enumerated class (that factor may be eliminable in this class)
any associativity or identity violation where composition is defined
any contract mismatch that composes silently
any regime pair where path-independence and square-commutation come apart in either direction
the donor strictly beats the six-factor witness on admitting decisions
cannot_check_conditions: the declared grid is not exhausted within the wallclock bound
the independent checker cannot be run

fields.t10: triples_examined, composable, associativity_violations, identity_violations, mismatches, silent_compositions

checker_and_authority_owner.independence_boundary: Both runner and checker are written in this session. This is two implementations inside one programme, not external adjudication, and the receipt must say so. EXTERNAL_SCIENTIFIC_ADJUDICATION remains CANNOT_CHECK for this job.

constitutional_note: This job may confirm, refute or narrow an instantiation. It may not redesign a theorem, move a gate, weaken the comparator, hide a negative, or rewrite theory after outcome access. If a genuine counterexample appears it is recorded here and narrows the theorem in a separately identified successor record; the merged theory is not mutated.
